main_text.p: parti ex æqvo acceptus, extincta fuisset traditio, atqve ex [?]בעל פה facta fuisset illo momento, [?]בכתב nullusqve fuisset locus argumento Rabbanistæ contra Karaitam. Nihil enim deus ad scripturæ complementum, post Esdram traditioni reliquisset. Hæc pro epistolæ modulo diffuse nimis. Propterea cætera paucis.

Petis qvem Karaitarum librum habeam? unicum habeo, qui in legem commentarius est manuscriptus, in folio non admodum magno, tres digitos aut circiter crassum: scribebat An.Chr. 1299 liber inscribitur [?]ספר המבחר autor R. Apharon filius Josephi. Ex eo autore manifestum est, Karaitas omnem scripturam veteris testamenti, non secus ac alii Judæi, amplecti. Solicitos admodum esse in explicandis Masorethicis & Grammaticis criticis, Talmud & Misnam non admittere ut regulam fidei, verum utilem sæpe ad Scripturæ illustrationem. Eadem est illis plane cum aliis Judæis, qvos Rabbanistas vocant controversia de scriptura & traditionibus,

page.notes: The Hebrew words "בעל פה" (line 1) and "בכתב" (line 2) are set in a slightly irregular form in the scan and are marked [?]. The Hebrew book title is read as "ספר המבחר" and is marked [?]; the letters of the final word are not fully clear. The year "1299" is in old-style numerals and is taken as printed. The Hebrew in the second line of the paragraph is printed inline, so the words are transcribed in their place. "traditioni-" / "bus," is joined as "traditionibus," at the line end.
